Sumitomo Osaka Cement.why: Its Optoelectronics business makes lithium niobate (LN) optical modulators for optical communications networks and data centers; the FY2026-28 plan launches a next-generation LN modulator (CDM) and ultra-high-speed optical modulation sub-assemblies, so optical-network build-outs drive its LN modulator sales.
Sumitomo Osaka Cement.evidence: Sumitomo Osaka Cement FY2026-28 Medium-Term Management Plan (05-13-2026): 'In the LN modulator business, launch sales of next-generation product (CDM) and prepare to sell ultra-high-speed optical modulation components (sub-assemblies).'

players.product: Lithium niobate (LN) optical modulators for optical communications, incl. next-generation LN modulator (CDM) and ultra-high-speed optical modulation sub-assemblies

quarterly_data.quarter: Sumitomo Osaka Cement medium-term management plan: FY2026-28 Medium-Term Management Plan (05-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026-28 plan for the LN (lithium niobate) modulator business: launch sales of the next-generation product (CDM) and prepare to sell ultra-high-speed optical modulation components (sub-assemblies); 2029 and beyond: expand sales of LN modulators and ultra-high-speed optical modulation components. Up to 2025 the company streamlined the LN modulator business and prepared the launch of next-generation products; making the LN modulator business profitable is listed as an issue that continues during the new plan ('Rebuilding the LN business')

quarterly_data.signal: Company view: increased capacity of communications networks and growth of the semiconductor market (AI) bring growing demand for modulators and electrostatic chucks (ESCs), alongside more severe development competition; its optoelectronics technology (LN modulator design, LN process development) serves optical communications networks and the expansion of data centers

quarterly_data.signal: FY2028 (FYE 3/2029) medium-term management targets: sales 255.5 billion yen (+31.8 billion yen vs FY2025), operating income 27 billion yen (10.5% operating income ratio; +13.4 billion yen vs FY2025), ROE 9% or more, ROIC 6% or more, total payout ratio 50% or more (3-year average), minimum dividend 120 yen/share; FY2035 operating income target 40 billion yen

quarterly_data.signal: Electronic Materials (semiconductor manufacturing equipment components) policy: owing to rapidly expanding use of AI and the construction of data centers, increasing demand for semiconductor memory and acceleration of semiconductor capital investment; the company plans to capture demand as investment in increased electrostatic chuck production materializes (new electronic materials manufacturing building, Ichikawa City, Chiba Prefecture), with a 10% hurdle rate for the business
